## Checklist

- [ ] `bash -n` passes for every changed script
- [ ] Nothing is hard-coded to one laptop (serials, PCI IDs, firmware names, user names)
- [ ] Scripts that write to a disk identify it by serial number, show what they will do, and ask for confirmation
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] No keys, images, `bm.conf` or personal data included
